Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Rajai Davis?

Rajai Davis is 45 years old.

When was Rajai Davis born?

Rajai Davis was born on October 19, 1980.

Where was Rajai Davis born?

Rajai Davis was born in Norwich, CT.

How tall is Rajai Davis?

Rajai Davis is 5-10 (178 cm) tall.

How much did Rajai Davis weigh when playing?

Rajai Davis weighed 195 lbs (88 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Rajai Davis play?

Rajai Davis played 14 seasons.

Is Rajai Davis in the Hall of Fame?

Rajai Davis has not been elected into the Hall of Fame.

When was Rajai Davis drafted?

Rajai Davis was drafted by the Pittsburgh Pirates in the 38th round of the 2001 MLB June Amateur Draft from University of Connecticut at Avery Point (Groton, CT).

What position did Rajai Davis play?

Rajai Davis was an Outfielder.

How many hits did Rajai Davis have?

Rajai Davis had 1,111 hits over his career.

How many home runs did Rajai Davis have?

Rajai Davis had 62 home runs over his career.

What was Rajai Davis' average?

Rajai Davis had a .262 average over his career.

How many teams has Rajai Davis played for?

Rajai Davis played for 8 teams; the Boston Red Sox, Cleveland Indians, Detroit Tigers, New York Mets, Oakland Athletics, Pittsburgh Pirates, San Francisco Giants and Toronto Blue Jays.

When did Rajai Davis retire?

Rajai Davis last played in 2019.

What are Rajai Davis' nicknames?

Raj is a nickname for Rajai Davis.
